g.aria-label: - Node 18 is no longer supported; Node 20 or newer is now required.
g.title: - Node 18 is no longer supported; Node 20 or newer is now required.

g.aria-label: - New `--watch` flag regenerates release notes whenever the repository changes.
g.title: - New `--watch` flag regenerates release notes whenever the repository changes.

g.aria-label: - Large diffs are now streamed instead of being buffered entirely in memory.
g.title: - Large diffs are now streamed instead of being buffered entirely in memory.

g.aria-label: - Expired auth tokens now fail with a 401 error instead of a 500.
g.title: - Expired auth tokens now fail with a 401 error instead of a 500.

g.aria-label: - An empty commit range is reported as empty rather than crashing.
g.title: - An empty commit range is reported as empty rather than crashing.

g.aria-label: - The parsed config is cached after first load, cutting startup time.
g.title: - The parsed config is cached after first load, cutting startup time.

g.aria-label: - Added a README with a quickstart showing a tag-to-HEAD range.
g.title: - Added a README with a quickstart showing a tag-to-HEAD range.

g.text: From raw commits to a changelog
